segments.label: arrival
segments.text: In 2022, we came to Canada from Ukraine with two kids.

segments.label: old_car
segments.text: Almost all the money we had went into an old car.

segments.label: renting
segments.text: We were renting. We had left our apartment back home.

segments.label: house_prices
segments.text: And when I saw houses selling for eight hundred thousand, nine hundred thousand, even a million dollars,

segments.label: impossible
segments.text: I remember thinking, this is not difficult. This is impossible.

segments.label: panic_passed
segments.text: But after the panic passed, my wife and I made one decision.

segments.label: try_anyway
segments.text: Maybe it is impossible. But let's still try.

segments.label: no_investing
segments.text: Back in Ukraine, we had never really invested.

segments.label: small_experiment
segments.text: One year before moving, I had only a couple thousand dollars to experiment with. That was it.

segments.label: research
segments.text: So in Canada, I started researching like someone who was already late.

segments.label: tools
segments.text: I learned about brokers. Employer matching. Cash-back accounts. Credit. Taxes.

segments.label: important
segments.text: And then I found something important.

segments.label: not_pro
segments.text: You do not need to be a professional investor to begin.

segments.label: etfs
segments.text: There are simple tools like ETFs, which are basically baskets of stocks.

segments.label: changed
segments.text: And for a beginner, that idea changed everything.

segments.label: expenses
segments.text: After rent, insurance, the car, kids, groceries, and all the normal bills, we did not have some huge amount left over.

segments.label: weekly
segments.text: But we decided to invest one hundred and fifty dollars a week.

segments.label: less_than_day
segments.text: That was less than I could make in a day.

segments.label: pointless
segments.text: At the beginning, it felt almost pointless.

segments.label: small_number
segments.text: You put money in, and the number still looks small.

segments.label: same_life
segments.text: Nothing dramatic happens. Nobody claps for you. Your life looks exactly the same.

segments.label: time_work
segments.text: But then time starts doing its quiet work.

segments.label: my_path
segments.text: I was interested in investing, so I picked individual stocks for my own accounts.

segments.label: wife_path
segments.text: My wife was not interested in stock picking, so for her accounts, I chose the simpler ETF path.

segments.label: my_result
segments.text: Four years later, my accounts are around fifty eight thousand six hundred dollars.

segments.label: wife_result
segments.text: Her accounts are around fifty four thousand five hundred.

segments.label: combined
segments.text: Together, that is about one hundred and thirteen thousand dollars.

segments.label: house_price
segments.text: And recently, we saw a similar house near the one we rent listed around five hundred twenty seven thousand dollars.

segments.label: old_question
segments.text: For the first time, the question was not, how could we ever buy a home?

segments.label: new_question
segments.text: The question became, should we buy one now, or keep growing?

segments.label: lesson_intro
segments.text: That is the part I did not understand at the beginning.

segments.label: not_rich
segments.text: The first financial goal after immigration is not getting rich.

segments.label: options
segments.text: It is getting stable enough to have options.

segments.label: capital
segments.text: Because once you have capital, time starts working differently.

segments.label: small_decisions
segments.text: A broker matters. Taxes matter. Cashback matters. Employer match matters. Small decisions stop being small.

segments.label: channel
segments.text: This channel is about that journey.

segments.label: promise
segments.text: Money after immigration. The mistakes, the tools, and the systems that helped us go from zero to options.
